name: KOHRA
bio: Kohra (Madhav Shorey) is a New Delhi-based electronic music producer and DJ, founder of Qilla Records (established 2011). "Kohra" means "fog or mist" in Urdu; "Qilla" means "fort or castle." A rock and metal drummer turned DJ, his travels and time studying at Swinburne University in Melbourne stoked his desire to create a homegrown scene for Delhi. He got his start as part of India's first widely recognized live electronica band, Jalebee Cartel. Through Qilla, he helped bring international attention to Indian underground dance music. His productions have appeared on Sol Selectas, Traum, Parquet, Steyoyoke, Motek, Blindfold, Tulipa, and Particles, many hitting Beatport Top 100 in over 4 genres. Tale of Us, Sam Paginini, Nick Warren, Joran Van Pol, Roy RosenfelD, Township Rebellion, Xenia Beliayeva, JSPR, and Atish have supported Qilla releases. He has shared stages with Pete Tong, Deadmau5, Dubfire, Richie Hawtin, Adam Beyer, Chris Liebing, Josh Wink, Patrice Baumel, Joseph Capriati, and Oliver Huntemann. In 2020, he released his debut album "akhõ", a 10-track LP paying homage to 17th-century mystic poet Kabir, blending ambient and progressive textures with breaks, electro, and jungle. John Digweed played half of it during his Bedrock Bunker Session. In 2024, Qilla celebrated its 100th release with the compilation "Chakravyūh" (spinning wheel in Sanskrit). 35 tracks of hypnotic techno and breaks, first Qilla release on vinyl, featuring pan-Asian artists. In 2024, launched "Sacred Alchemy" club nights at antiSOCIAL Mumbai and Beats Per Minute Hyderabad. Announced plans for 4 vinyl releases per year and revival of Alchemy festival.

name: DJ SARTEK
bio: First Indian on Hardwell's Revealed Recordings. Opened for David Guetta, Martin Garrix, Tiesto.

name: SANDUNES
bio: One of India's most prominent electronic producers. Apple Music Up Next 2022, Red Bull Music Academy BaseCamp Dubai.

name: ANISH KUMAR
bio: Anish Kumar is a Britain-based DJ and producer making house and Italo disco with sampled Indian and Bollywood sounds. His AK Cuts series runs across four EPs, from October 2025 to July 2026. He has sold out Village Underground in London and played Panorama Bar in Berlin.
